mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increases the discount rate for equity cash flows, compressing valuation multiples and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the cost of capital rises for corporate investment.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of observations when FEDFUNDS exceeds 3.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 0.2 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce corporate profit expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high unemployment (UNRATE > 4.0%) and declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signal a dual economic stress scenario where corporate earnings face headwinds from both labor market weakness and supply constraints, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0 and INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), elevated interest rates compress equity valuation multiples through higher discount rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as capital costs rise for corporations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of observations during monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1,300,000 units signals weak consumer demand and reduced construction activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as economic growth prospects deteriorate.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST < 1300.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in retail sales (RSAFS < 730,000) and housing starts (HOUST < 1,300) indicate broad-based consumer demand weakness that reduces corporate revenue visibility, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through earnings downgrades.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when RSAFS < 730000 and HOUST < 1300.0, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (2017=100) signals manufacturing contraction and supply chain disruptions that reduce corporate output capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as profit margins compress.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increases the cost of capital for long-term equity investments, compressing valuation multiples and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as discount rates rise for future cash flows.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of observations when FEDFUNDS exceeds 3.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
